Subject: Quick stock check / Apex Smart Solutions

Hey team,

Dropped by your catalog and wanted to check if you have these items ready to ship out of your warehouse? Looking for a ballpark quote as well:

- 50 units x OmniCharge Wireless Hub (Black)
- 120 pcs - Lumina Desk LED Pro (Silver)
- 30x Ergonomic Monitor Arm Single V2

Are you experiencing any supply chain delays on these right now? If we lock this in, we'd need them delivered to our Austin hub by late November.

Appreciate a quick reply!

Best,
Sarah Jenkins
Purchasing Lead | Apex Smart Solutions
104 E 2nd St, Austin, TX 78701, USA
[s.jenkins@apexsmart-tech.com](mailto:s.jenkins@apexsmart-tech.com) | +1 (512) 555-0192

Subject: PURCHASE ORDER: PO-2026-99482 (Nippon Cybernetics Corp.)

Dear Sales Department,

Please find our formal request for procurement below. We require immediate confirmation regarding production capacity and strict adherence to the stated delivery deadline.

Order Details:

1. Model: FX-9000 Control Board / Quantity: 15 Units
2. Model: S-20 Sensor Assembly / Quantity: 200 Units
3. Model: Heavy-Duty Servo Drive SD-x / Quantity: 8 Units

All items must pass your standard QA protocol before dispatch. Delivery is required at our Yokohama distribution facility no later than Friday, October 30, 2026. Please return the signed order acknowledgement within 24 hours.

Sincerely,
Kenji Tanaka
Director of Logistics
Nippon Cybernetics Corp.
Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
[k-tanaka@nippon-cybernetics.co.jp](mailto:k-tanaka@nippon-cybernetics.co.jp)

- 6x AeroBrew Commercial Espresso Maker (3-Group)
- 15 units - GrindMaster Pro 800
- Barista Toolkit Type-A (Need 40 sets)

Can your logistics partner guarantee delivery to our Berlin Mitte location by October 12? Any delay will ruin our launch schedule. Let me know asap.

Regards,
Marc Lehmann
Operations
Berlin Cafe Supplies GmbH
Friedrichstraße 95, 10117 Berlin, Germany

Subject: Technical specification approval - SolarVolt Brazil

Prezados,

We are reviewing the draft agreement for our Q4 infrastructure project. Our engineering team has approved your catalog specifications, provided you can supply the exact variations listed here:

• Helios-450W Solar Panel (Mono-PERC) -> 500 Modules
• Inverter SmartVolt 10KTL -> 12 Units
• Aluminum Railing Mount Set (Heavy Wind Variant) -> 150 Kits

Please verify if the full batch can be shipped under a single Bill of Lading to Port of Santos. We intend to finalize the transaction once you confirm that custom clearance documentation will be prepared on your end.

Kind regards,
Camila Ribeiro
Senior Procurement Engineer
SolarVolt Energia S.A.
Av. Paulista, 1000, São Paulo, Brazil
[c.ribeiro@solarvolt-energia.br](mailto:c.ribeiro@solarvolt-energia.br)
